copyMode: Independent regular files; preserve verified relative internal node_modules bin symlinks; no hardlinks or external symlinks.
dependencyInventoryEncoding: SHA256(JSON compact array of {path,bytes,sha256}, iterated by sorted(Path.rglob), paths relative to checkout; regular files only).
scope: Build prerequisites only. No build, test, game, performance measurement, Git mutation, publication or change to source checkout. Root performs source integration and publication.
